name: hawaiian
note: The Hawaiian Resort pack on Meshy, the fifth of the US golf courses' landscapes (7 November 2026): Kapalua, Mauna Kea. Cook pine, ironwood and monkeypod are new here; its coconut palm is Florida Palms'. Form from the owner's Kapalua photographs, tall narrow uneven Cook pines standing in lines, and the reference photographs of Wailea and Waikoloa for the monkeypod. Sizes PLACED. The monkeypod's wide umbrella is its identity, so it stays about as wide as tall, against the owner's usual taller and skinnier: narrowed from a real one, which is much wider. `seasons` are PLACED. Shipped in vendor/blender-meshy_hawaiian as HiCookPine, HiIronwood, HiMonkeypod, because the hand-built models hold the plain names.
style: Stylised cartoon game art in soft, flat painted colour. Simple clean shapes with a gentle gradient: darker near the trunk and under each bough, lighter toward the tips. Matte, muted natural palette. No photographic detail, no photo bark, no noise, no speckle, no hard shadows, no highlights, no shine, no ink outlines, no text.
view: One view only, seen from the side at eye level, the whole plant in frame from foot to tip with a margin around it, centred, on a plain white background, in even soft light, with no cast shadow.
